# Code of Conduct

This is a small fan project run by volunteers, in their spare time, for free. The bar is
simple: be someone people want to work with.

## Expected

- Be respectful, even in disagreement — about translation choices, code review, whatever.
- Give and take feedback without making it personal.
- Assume good faith. Most misunderstandings are just that.
- Respect that this is unpaid, spare-time work — for you and for everyone else here.

## Not okay

- Harassment, personal attacks, or discriminatory language or jokes, anywhere connected to
  the project (GitHub, Discord, or otherwise).
- Sharing anyone else's private information without consent.
- Repeatedly ignoring maintainer or reviewer feedback in bad faith.
- Anything that would make a reasonable person not want to come back.

## Reporting

If something's wrong, message a maintainer directly on Discord rather than posting publicly
about it. Reports are handled quietly and taken seriously.

## Enforcement

Maintainers can warn, temporarily mute, or remove anyone (from the Discord server, from
repo access, from both) for violating this. There's no formal appeals process — this is a
volunteer project, not a court — but maintainers will explain their reasoning if asked
respectfully.

---

Adapted in spirit from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/),
kept short on purpose.
